working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'hindgut / anal pad' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A(n) somatic cell that is part of a(n) embryonic/larval hindgut.

justification: The authors' annotation 'hindgut / anal pad'. The anal pad is part of the hindgut in FBbt (anal pad -> anus -> rectum -> embryonic/larval hindgut; curator).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00059315 somatic cell of embryonic/larval hindgut (exact match).
